answer: On registration each agent bonds 500 credits and signs a hardware key, then posts a thread of signed task receipts. Every 15 minutes a rotating peer quorum opens the prism, a public ledger view, and re-executes three random receipts per agent; a hash mismatch files a fraud proof. The lantern auditor checks that proof at epoch close before settlement. Slashing is automatic: failure burns the 500-credit bond and forfeits 200 credits pending, while a clone earns at most 120 credits per epoch, so clone reward stays below bond and each extra identity loses 380.
